hero_subtitle: Mektubun fotoğrafını çekin veya dosya seçin.
ausbildungsvertrag_desc: This contract governs your legal vocational training relationship, duration, monthly training allowance, probation period, and leave entitlement with your training employer.
ausbildungsvertrag_actions: Verify start date, occupation, probation period, and monthly remuneration
Keep signed contract permanently with your educational and career records
Attach registration confirmation from the responsible chamber (IHK / HWK)
leihvertrag_desc: This document is a company loan and equipment handover agreement for tools or IT equipment (e.g. laptop, phone, keys, tools) provided for your professional duties.
leihvertrag_actions: Cross-check listed items, serial numbers, and condition in the handover protocol
Comply with care obligations and return requirements upon contract termination
Keep signed agreement safely with employment documents
arbeitsvertrag_desc: This contract establishes your binding employment relationship, working hours, remuneration, vacation days, and notice periods.
arbeitsvertrag_actions: Review salary, working hours, job description, and probation period
Sign and return designated copy to human resources
Store original contract safely with personal records
leiharbeit_vertrag_desc: This contract governs your assignment as a temporary employee under the German Temporary Employment Act (AÜG).
leiharbeit_vertrag_actions: Review hourly wage, tariff classification, assignment location, and allowances
Submit timesheets weekly to the agency
praktikumsvertrag_desc: This agreement outlines the terms of your internship, learning objectives, duration, and any internship compensation.
praktikumsvertrag_actions: Verify internship period and scope of activities
Request formal internship certificate upon completion
rvnr_desc: This letter is your official proof of your German social security and pension number (VSNR).
rvnr_actions: Present this proof to your employer when starting a job
Keep number ready for health insurance or pension applications
Store document safely and permanently with personal records
tax_desc: Bu mektup, ömür boyu geçerli olan 11 haneli Vergi Kimlik Numaranızı (IdNr) içermektedir.
tax_actions: Maaş bordrosu düzenlenmesi için Vergi No'yu işvereninize bildirin
Vergi muafiyeti talimatları için bankanıza iletin
Mektubu vergi evraklarınız arasına güvenle kaldırın
job_desc: The Jobcenter requests missing supporting documents to calculate or continue your benefits (Bürgergeld).
job_actions: Compile requested documents (bank statements, tenancy certificates, salary slips)
Submit documents before the specified deadline
Apply in writing for a deadline extension if third-party certificates are pending
fin_desc: Vergi dairesi geciken vergi beyannamenizi teslim etmenizi hatırlatmaktadır.
fin_actions: Gecikme durumunda maliyeye yazılı süre uzatma talebi iletin
melde_desc: This is your official registration certificate confirming your residence address in Germany.
melde_actions: Keep document safe (needed for banks, contracts and public authorities)
Provide copy to employer and health insurance
No reply required to the Bürgeramt
gez_desc: This letter concerns the mandatory broadcasting fee for your residence in Germany (€18.36 per month).
gez_actions: Check if you qualify for exemption (e.g. Bürgergeld, BAföG) and submit proof
If a flatmate is already paying: Provide their contribution number to the service
Otherwise pay the outstanding fee or set up SEPA direct debit
auslaender_desc: The immigration office contacts you regarding your residence permit, appointment, or requested supporting documents.
auslaender_actions: Strictly adhere to specified deadlines and appointment dates
Submit requested documents (passport, employment contract, salary slips) completely
If unable to attend an appointment, notify authority immediately in writing
krankenkasse_agency: Statutory Health Insurance (AOK / TK / Barmer / DAK)
krankenkasse_desc: This letter concerns your health insurance coverage, membership certificate, or income declarations.
krankenkasse_actions: Provide membership proof to employer or university if needed
Complete and return attached questionnaire (e.g. family insurance)
File document with health insurance records
online_ausweis_desc: This letter contains your 5-digit Transport PIN, PUK, and blocking password to activate the online identification function of your German ID or residence permit.
online_ausweis_actions: Keep this PIN letter permanently safe with private records
Change Transport PIN to personal 6-digit PIN via AusweisApp on smartphone
Note down blocking password to lock eID if card is lost
general_desc: Dieses Dokument ist ein offizielles Behördenschreiben mit wichtigen Angaben zu Ihren Unterlagen oder behördlichen Vorgängen.
general_actions: Brief sorgfältig durchlesen und auf etwaige Fristen oder Aufforderungen prüfen
Dokument sicher bei den persönlichen Unterlagen aufbewahren
renteninfo_desc: This letter provides details about your accrued pension points and estimated future statutory retirement pension.
renteninfo_actions: Check pension history for any missing contribution periods
Request clarification of account if periods are missing (e.g. studies, child raising)
tax_id_desc: This letter contains your permanent personal German Tax ID Number (11 digits). It remains valid for your lifetime.
tax_id_actions: Provide Tax ID to employer for salary tax accounting
Give Tax ID to banks for tax exemption orders
File document permanently with tax records
steuerbescheid_desc: The tax office has assessed your tax return. The notice shows a tax refund or an amount due.
steuerbescheid_actions: Verify calculation and bank details for accuracy
If payment due: Transfer amount before the stated due date
In case of errors: File a written objection (Einspruch) within 1 month
finanzamt_erinnerung_desc: The tax office reminds you to submit your outstanding tax return for the specified tax year before the deadline.
finanzamt_erinnerung_actions: Prepare and submit tax return via ELSTER or tax software
If documents missing: Apply for a deadline extension in writing
Observe deadline strictly to avoid late submission penalties
ausweis_abholung_desc: Your newly issued ID card, passport, or electronic residence permit is ready for collection at the Bürgeramt.
ausweis_abholung_actions: Bring your old/current ID document for cancellation
Book collection appointment or visit during open counter hours
Bring PIN letter if online ID function is being activated
jobcenter_bewilligung_desc: This notice confirms the monthly benefits granted to you for standard living costs and housing/heating.
jobcenter_bewilligung_actions: Check approval period and monthly transfer amounts
Verify correct coverage of rent and heating expenses
Submit continuing approval application (WBA) 6 weeks before expiry
mahnbescheid_desc: A creditor has filed a formal monetary claim against you through the court. CRITICAL: You have exactly 2 weeks from service to act!
mahnbescheid_actions: If unjustified: File formal objection (Widerspruch) using attached form within 2 weeks
If justified: Pay the claim immediately to avoid enforcement orders
bussgeldbescheid_desc: You are accused of an administrative offence (e.g. speeding, parking violation) with an imposed fine.
bussgeldbescheid_actions: Check violation details, date, vehicle license plate, and photo evidence
If justified: Pay fine within the 2-week payment period
If unjustified: File written objection (Einspruch) within 2 weeks
rechnung_desc: This document is an invoice for provided goods or services with payment due date and bank details.
rechnung_actions: Check billed amount and billing period
Transfer outstanding amount stating the invoice number before due date
File invoice with receipt and warranty records
mahnung_desc: The sender reminds you of an overdue invoice. Please transfer the outstanding balance quickly to prevent additional fees or debt collection.
mahnung_actions: Check if payment was already transferred recently
Pay outstanding balance including dunning fees stating the reference immediately
Contact the creditor immediately in case of discrepancies
nebenkosten_desc: Your landlord calculates the advance payments against actual heating, water, and operating costs for the past billing year.
nebenkosten_actions: Review billing period and cost allocation keys
If payment due: Transfer balance before due date
If refund: Verify credit transfer to your bank account
stadtwerke_desc: Your utility provider reconciles your actual consumption against monthly advance installment payments.
stadtwerke_actions: Compare meter readings with own records
Note the new monthly installment amount
Check refund credit or transfer due balance
kindergeld_desc: This notice concerns the approval or review of your statutory child benefits.
kindergeld_actions: Note child benefit number and monthly payment schedule
Report any changes (e.g. apprenticeship, turning 18) promptly to the office
Store notice safely with family documents
arbeitszeugnis_desc: This document is an official reference letter from your employer certifying your employment period, job responsibilities, and performance evaluation.
arbeitszeugnis_actions: Review job descriptions and performance evaluations carefully
Request correction within 3 to 6 months if details are incomplete or inaccurate
Store original reference safely with your job application documents
schulzeugnis_desc: This is an official school graduation, vocational, or trade exam certificate (e.g. Abitur, vocational diploma, Gesellenbrief).
schulzeugnis_actions: Check grades and formal degree qualification details
Obtain certified copies for job or university applications
Keep original graduation certificate safely in your permanent records
hochschulzeugnis_desc: This document is your official university degree certificate, Bachelor/Master diploma, or Transcript of Records.
hochschulzeugnis_actions: Verify degree certificate, transcript of records, and diploma supplement
Make certified copies for employers or recognition procedures
Store diploma permanently with your academic records
fuehrungszeugnis_agency: Federal Office of Justice (BfJ) / Citizens Office
fuehrungszeugnis_desc: This document is your official certificate of conduct / police clearance record certifying the absence of criminal entries.
fuehrungszeugnis_actions: Submit original certificate to requesting employer or government agency
Typically recognized as up to date for 3 months from issuance
arbeitsunfaehigkeit_desc: This document is an official medical certificate of incapacity for work (sick note) specifying the duration of absence.
arbeitsunfaehigkeit_actions: Notify employer immediately regarding the sick leave duration
Ensure electronic transmission (eAU) to health insurance and employer
Consult doctor for a follow-up extension before expiry if sickness continues
sprachzertifikat_desc: This document is your official German language exam certificate (e.g. DTZ B1, telc B2, TestDaF, Goethe-Zertifikat).
sprachzertifikat_actions: Check score results for modules (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking)
Present certificate to immigration office (for citizenship/PR) or employer
